en: A black‑and‑white rural scene showing wooden farmhouses and fields. In the foreground, a large timber house with steep roof and white‑framed windows stands on the left, with people and bicycles near the fence. A dirt road runs into open farmland toward several scattered wooden buildings in the distance. The style evokes an early 20th‑century Scandinavian countryside. Printed text at the top reads "Parti ved Hov i Løiten."
